messages:
Connor O'Brien: heads up for this week’s release train — we have a bunch of Suggestions beta pieces landing (UI + BFF + service endpoints). Need to coordinate timing + flag rollout + comms checklist so we don’t surprise Support / oncall.

Talia Benson: +1. What’s the target day for prod deploy? and is this still read-only behind flags?

Dylan Brooks: yep still read-only. UI routes + drawer behind `suggestions_beta` (server + client). No “apply” actions.

Chloe Martin: BFF hits suggestions-service `GET /suggestions` + `GET /suggestions/{id}`. Tenant scoping is in. We also have allowlist check before returning anything.

Connor O'Brien: ok, proposal:
1) ship code to prod with flags OFF (default)
2) validate in staging with flags ON for a couple internal workspaces
3) enable allowlist for initial cohort in prod after deploy (no additional code)

Marissa Cole: works. We should also align on the “announcement timing” so PM/CS can tell customers when it’s actually visible.

Chris Osei: for comms, I need an exact window. Customers will ask “when can I see it” and we don’t want to say “after deploy sometime”.

Connor O'Brien: current train window is Thu 10:00–12:00 PT for prod. If we keep flags off, visibility is purely when we flip allowlist after smoke test.

Rafael Mendes: SRE request: please don’t flip allowlist immediately at deploy time. Give us at least 30–60 mins to watch error rate + p95 on the service + BFF.

Connor O'Brien: yep. Suggest: deploy Thu 10–12 PT, smoke in prod with flags off (just health), then enable allowlist at ~13:00 PT for 1–2 tenants, expand after 30 mins.

Logan Wright: note on telemetry freshness: savings estimates depend on baselines. We should have a gate in UI for “insufficient data” but I’d rather we keep cohort small day 1.

Dev Patel: +1 from Support. Please confirm what the customer sees if telemetry is missing. We need a canned response.

Marissa Cole: UX has an empty state: “No suggestions yet” + a “Why you might not see suggestions” link. Also “Insufficient telemetry” message on the drawer.

Leila Farouk: QA plan: we can do a quick pass in staging Wed EOD. Need the staging flags + one seeded workspace that actually has suggestions.

Chloe Martin: I can turn on staging for `redwood-internal` + `console-sandbox` and drop a couple fake suggestions via the seed job.

FeatureFlagBot: Reminder: `suggestions_beta` has scopes [server, client]. Default: off. Allowlist groups: `suggestions_beta_cohort`.

Connor O'Brien: great. Checklist draft (reply w/ gaps):
- [ ] Code merged by Wed 17:00 PT (Console + BFF + service)
- [ ] Staging smoke w/ flags ON (Wed night)
- [ ] Prod deploy Thu train (flags OFF)
- [ ] Post-deploy monitoring 60 mins (Dashboards: suggestions-service p95, 5xx, stale estimates)
- [ ] Enable allowlist for 1–2 tenants (Thu ~13:00 PT)
- [ ] Confirm RBAC perms (view-only) + audit log entries
- [ ] Support FAQ / macros updated
- [ ] #announcements internal post + escalation path

Talia Benson: add “rollback plan” explicitly (is it just toggling allowlist + flags?)

Dylan Brooks: rollback is: remove allowlist group + disable flag. Also we can disable BFF route exposure entirely via server flag.

Rafael Mendes: and add an “incident threshold” so we know when to pause. e.g. service 5xx > 2% for 5 mins OR p95 > 2s OR stale estimate % spikes.

Connor O'Brien: ok will add. Also who’s on point to flip allowlist? (release eng can do, but prefer product ops owns the cohort enabling)

Chris Osei: I can own allowlist flips in prod, but I need the exact group name + where in the admin tool.

Chloe Martin: group is `suggestions_beta_cohort`. Admin tool: Console → Admin → Feature Flags → Allowlist. I’ll DM you a screenshot.

Dev Patel: comms checklist: please include “Support readiness” explicitly:
- link to docs draft
- escalation channel (#support-oncall?)
- known limitations (read-only, estimates can change, confidence not shown yet)

Marissa Cole: + “copy disclaimers reviewed” — we’re using “Estimated savings” everywhere, not “you will save”.

Leila Farouk: QA asks: can we get a prod-only sanity check doc? Like 5 steps to verify after deploy before enabling cohort.

Connor O'Brien: yep. Draft steps:
1) open Console in prod (as internal) and verify Suggestions nav item is hidden when flag off
2) toggle flag on for internal workspace only; verify list loads, filters work, drawer opens
3) confirm audit log entry on drawer open
4) verify empty state for workspace w/ no telemetry
5) check dashboards: error rate + p95 stable

DeployBot: Prod release train scheduled: Thu 10:00–12:00 PT. Change freeze begins 12:30 PT.

Talia Benson: freeze means cohort enablement should happen before 12:30?

Connor O'Brien: enablement is config-only, but let’s still do initial flip before freeze. We can keep expansion to additional tenants for next day if needed.

Chris Osei: works. I’ll plan: Thu 12:00 PT enable 1 tenant, watch 30 mins, then 2nd tenant if clean.

Rafael Mendes: please post in #eng-sre when you flip the first tenant (include tenant/workspace ID + expected traffic volume).

Logan Wright: and tag me if we see “insufficient telemetry” complaints; we’ve got one known edge case when baselines lag.

Connor O'Brien: action items:
- Chloe: staging enablement + seeded suggestions by Wed noon
- Leila: staging QA pass Wed EOD
- Marissa/Chris/Dev: finalize comms + FAQ copy by Thu morning
- Rafael: confirm monitoring thresholds + runbook link
- Connor: prep release notes + deploy checklist in #eng-releases

Marissa Cole: 👍

Dev Patel: 👍 will update Support doc + macros

Rafael Mendes: 👍 will drop thresholds + dashboard links here

Connor O'Brien: cool. I’ll post a short internal announcement template once we confirm staging passes.
